newsitem.title: UK: GNI sees coffee prices rising to $1.30/lb.
newsitem.headline: GNI sees coffee prices rising to $1.30/lb.

text.p: Coffee prices are expected to rise to around $1.30 a lb basis New York over the coming months on the back of significantly lower consumer stocks, broker GNI said.
In a report, the brokerage said the price could possibly even rise to $1.60. New York prices basis March hovered at around $1.18 on Monday.
But it said producer selling is likely to dampen the possibility of a rally beyond that level.
"Sentiment will also be determined by the forecasts for Brazil next year, and any 'reliable' forecast calling for a sub 28.5 million bag crop should be viewed positively," it said.
GNI said the world market could remain tight, even with a Brazilian crop of around 28.5 million bags in 1997/98.

"While consumer stocks should start their seasonal build in the near future, it is unlikely they will rise to the degree that many roasters are anticipating," it said. -- Jalil Hamid, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4985
